doc_summary: natural spawning's maximum cluster size on the server: `native_spawn_cluster_size(kind, position, default_size, size)`, NeoForge's `SpawnClusterSizeEvent` at `NaturalSpawner.spawnCategoryForPosition`, asked after each mob of a cluster spawns. Set `size` to `Some(n)` to replace `default_size`, `Mob.getMaxSpawnClusterSize`. Horizon supplies the mob type and position rather than an entity ID because it assigns IDs later. Bundles need "hooks": @API:spawn_cluster_size@.
